targets.query:
from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: -20s)
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
    r.host =~ /^${Host:regex}$/ and
    r._measurement == "system" and
    r._field == "n_users"
  )
  |> keep(columns: ["_value"])
  |> last()

panels.title: Active Users
panels.description: Logged-in shell sessions on the firewall (SSH or console). Web GUI logins are not counted. Shows 0 when Telegraf reports no user count.

targets.query:

  )
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_value:r._value, _time:r._time, _field:r._field}))

panels.title: Gateway RTT - $Gateway
panels.description: dpinger's rolling average round-trip time (ms) to each gateway's monitor IP, averaged per graph interval. If your ISP deprioritises ICMP, set another monitor IP under System > Gateways.

from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: -30s)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => 
    r.host =~ /^${Host:regex}$/ and
    r.interface =~ /^${WAN:regex}$/ and
    r._measurement == "net" and
    r._field =~ /bytes_recv|bytes_sent/
  )
  |> derivative(unit:1s)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      r with
      _value: r._value * 8.0
    })
  )
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 10s, fn: last)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_value:r._value, _time:r._time, _field:r._field}))
  |> last()

  )
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1h, fn: last)
  |> difference(nonNegative: true)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_value:r._value, _time:r._time, _field:r._field}))
